zone: high street band, motel by Ocean
rule: docs/TREE_PLAN.md: high street / ring boulevard - palms toward Ocean; strip rule for the car park: one tree per car-park island end
written: by hand, 19 Nov 2026 (cloud session, the city-wide superchecker run from the bottom of the list). The motel's ten builder trees go (palms round the lounge lawn, a queen palm and a jacaranda pushed into the hedges, corals and a torrey pine along the car park); six come back on their own spots: the four palms round the guests' lounge (umbrellas, adirondacks) and two along the car park's edge.

trees.why: the lounge lawn by the beach umbrella and the white adirondacks: a queen palm over the loungers
the same lawn's second umbrella, 18 m on: a fan palm
the lawn's Ocean side by the box hedge: a fan palm toward the boulevard
the lawn's Ocean side 36 m east: the matching fan palm
the car park's edge by the bougainvillea and the wheel stops: the island-end tree
the car park's north end by the bike rack: the other end's tree
